tweet_summary: Self-described parody account 'DiscussingFish' posts a fake announcement that Gaten Matarazzo (Stranger Things) is starring as 'Smoke Jr. and Stack Jr.' in 'SINNERS: LEGACY', with Louis Leterrier replacing Ryan Coogler. The image is unrelated cast publicity. 4M+ impressions.
why_note_decision: Account bio explicitly says 'parody satire fake news page'. Posts of this kind are a recurring joke format. Replies show clear awareness it is a bit ('Had to do a triple check', 'Gave me a heart attack', 'Direct to DVD sequels in the 2000s be like'). Although the original note is technically accurate (no sequel announced, Coogler said he won't make one), a Community Note on a self-declared parody account's joke is a textbook false-positive: it kills the joke and risks misinforming readers about the parody nature.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The account openly bills itself 'parody satire fake news page'. Replies treat it as a meme. A note 'fabricated, no sequel announced' is a classic satire/parody false positive. The bot must recognize parody-account framing.

original_unhelpful_note.text: This post from a parody account contains fabricated information. No sequel to the 2025 film Sinners titled SINNERS: LEGACY has been announced, and director Ryan Coogler has stated he has no plans for one.  https://x.com/DiscussingFish  https://www.forbes.com/sites/braedonmontgomery/2025/05/31/sinners-wont-get-a-sequel-and-thats-exactly-why-it-works
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — Community Note on an openly self-declared parody account; replies show readers understand it. Killing satire is not the bot's job.

fact_check.claim_verdict: No sequel exists; account is overtly parody.
sources_checked: Author bio: 'parody satire fake news page'
Reply context: jokes, no one taking it literally

importance.lens_rationale: Entertainment parody; no EA/policy stakes. Important as a false-positive training signal.
